verified_bug_fix.original_issue: Legacy user agimk/afrimk could not login due to Admin AI password reset creating force_password_change even when email delivery failed
verified_bug_fix.root_cause: Admin AI password reset (_issue_password_reset) was setting force_password_change=True regardless of email delivery success, causing login block for users who never received the reset email
verified_bug_fix.fix_applied: 1) _issue_password_reset now only sets force_password_change=True when email_sent=True. 2) _maybe_clear_unenforceable_password_reset() auto-clears stale admin_ai_reset enforcement when email was not delivered. 3) Admin customer search expanded to include email_aliases in search query.
verified_bug_fix.verification_result: PASS - All login flows work, alias search works, no 403 password reset blocks

test_scope: Legacy user auth/data issue: login with agimk@me.com, alias login with afrimk@me.com, admin customer/wallet search by alias, search for non-existent users
